Leftover: most of the soy sauce, the wasabi and a little soup residue (~25 kcal). The ginger appears eaten.

Eaten: about 1100 kcal.

- Carbs: soup 25 g, cake 35 g, cola 27 g, sushi 38 g, sandwich 35 g, ginger 4 g, giving about 164 g.
- Fat: soup 7 g, cake 11 g, sushi 2 g, sandwich 18 g, giving about 38 g.

The macros work out to roughly 1170 kcal, slightly above the energy estimate, so I adjusted them down a little.
